name: Payment Support for the EU Digital Identity Wallet Community Group
description:
The mission for this group is to propose and if possible consolidate different aspects of payment authorizations using the EU Digital Identity Wallet. This includes:

  • UX considerations
  • Different flows like "push-through" and 3D Secure/Oauth2
  • Electronic receipts
  • Account balance reports
  • Local payments
  • Person-to-Person payments
  • Possible innovation with respect to other systems
This group may publish Specifications.
